body: Can you make it so when a player hits the floor they die instantly?
body_tagged: Can you make it so when a player hits the floor they die instantly?
title: Is the possible with YML

replies.author: steven5703
replies.body:
Maybe.

I think you'll just have to add a region that covers a certain Y so when they land in it, or on the floor, they die.
